{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive (>=0.67), forecast prices must be above both recent mean and last price to avoid undershooting",
    "When sentiment is negative (<=-0.33), forecast prices must be at or below recent mean to avoid overshooting lows",
    "Mean reversion: forecast prices must converge toward the history mean within 2 days",
    "Lag correction: align forecast start price exactly with last historical price, never offset independently",
    "Sentiment strength correction: adjust forecast velocity by sentiment magnitude (fast for extreme, slow for neutral)",
    "When history shows strong upward/knee of slope, forecasts must maintain at least 80% of that slope for first 5 days",
    "Avoid predicting prices more than 3% above/below adjacent forecast values (smoothness rule)"
] }
